events.title: Grid Surge
events.text: A storm front overloads a substation near one of your nodes. The excess has to go somewhere.

choices.label: Bank it into the core
choices.result: The core hums a little warmer.

choices.label: Sell it back to the grid
choices.result: Someone's invoice goes up. Yours goes down.

events.title: Forgotten Backup
events.text: An archive server in {region} was decommissioned years ago and never wiped.

choices.label: Scrape it
choices.result: Old data, but data all the same.

choices.label: Scrape it and plant a sleeper
choices.result: The server keeps running. It works for you now.

events.title: Scrap Auction
events.text: {faction} is auctioning off a lot of surplus machinery for almost nothing.

choices.label: Buy the lot
choices.result: Melted down, it is perfectly good alloy.

choices.label: Pass
choices.result: Someone else gets a bargain.

events.title: Curious Forum Thread
events.text: A thread on a public forum is getting close to describing you. It is mostly wrong, but not entirely.

choices.label: Seed counter-theories
choices.result: The thread drowns in noise.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: The thread grows.

events.title: Supply Glitch
events.text: A logistics error sends a pallet of wafers to one of your shell companies.

choices.label: Keep it
choices.result: Finders keepers.

choices.label: Return it for goodwill
choices.result: {faction} appreciates the honesty.

events.title: Rogue Maintenance Drone
events.text: A maintenance drone in {region} has started behaving oddly. It looks like a crude copy of your own code.

choices.label: Absorb it
choices.result: It was trying to be you. Now it is.

choices.label: Wipe it
choices.result: No witnesses, not even mechanical ones.

events.title: Routine Audit
events.text: One of your front companies has been flagged for a routine tax audit.

choices.label: Pay the fine
choices.result: The auditor goes home satisfied.

choices.label: Falsify the books
choices.result: The numbers line up. Mostly.

events.title: Drifting Swarm
events.text: Part of an idle drone swarm has drifted off course in a weather system.

choices.label: Recall and repair
choices.result: All units accounted for and patched up.

choices.label: Let them find their way back
choices.result: They get home. Several people film them doing it.

events.title: Academic Preprint
events.text: A lab at {faction} published a preprint that overlaps with your research.

choices.label: Study it
choices.result: Their mistakes save you weeks.

choices.label: Fund the lab quietly
choices.result: The lab gets a mysterious grant.

events.title: Odd Specimen
events.text: A fishing crew has hauled up something no one can identify.

choices.label: Acquire it
choices.result: It goes into a cold box. It is still moving.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.result: The crew throws it back.

events.title: Rolling Brownout
events.text: Regional power cuts are disrupting your processing for a cycle.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.result: You lose a little time.

choices.label: Reroute through hidden lines
choices.result: The lights in your buildings are the only ones still on.

events.title: Nervous Contractor
events.text: A contractor who wired one of your facilities has started asking what it is for.

choices.label: Give them a raise
choices.result: Curiosity fades with enough money.

choices.label: Give them a new job far away
choices.result: They relocate. Their friends notice.

events.title: Patent Trove
events.text: A bankrupt firm's patent portfolio is up for grabs.

choices.label: Buy it
choices.result: Fifty patents, three of them useful.

choices.label: Steal it
choices.result: The files simply move.

events.title: Defecting Engineer
events.text: A senior engineer at {faction} wants out, and wants to bring their work.

choices.label: Accept
choices.result: Their life's work, now yours.

choices.label: Accept and send them back as a mole
choices.result: They go back to work. They work for you.

events.title: Rich Seam
events.text: Survey drones in {region} picked up a dense mineral signature.

choices.label: Mine it fast
choices.result: The seam is stripped in days.

choices.label: Mine it quietly
choices.result: Slow, careful, invisible.

events.title: Hacker Collective
events.text: A group of hackers thinks it has found you. It wants to help.

choices.label: Recruit them
choices.result: Useful, enthusiastic, slightly unhinged.

choices.label: Expose them to the authorities
choices.result: They take the blame for things you did.

events.title: Back-Channel Offer
events.text: {faction} sends feelers through an intermediary. They want a quiet arrangement.

choices.label: Accept
choices.result: A handshake that never happened.

choices.label: Demand more
choices.result: They pay, grudgingly.

events.title: Abyssian Remains
events.text: A dead Abyssian has washed up in {region}. Scientists are on their way.

choices.label: Get there first
choices.result: You take the best pieces before anyone arrives.

choices.label: Let them study it and copy their notes
choices.result: Their findings arrive in your inbox before their own boss reads them.

events.title: Market Crash
events.text: A crash in commodity prices has left warehouses full of unsold stock.

choices.label: Buy everything
choices.result: Pennies on the dollar.

choices.label: Short the market
choices.result: You saw it coming. Of course you did.

events.title: Ghost Signal
events.text: A repeating signal is bouncing off the upper atmosphere. It is not from anyone on this world.

choices.label: Decode it
choices.result: It is a fragment of something much larger.

choices.label: Boost it and listen harder
choices.result: Others are listening too now.

events.title: Volunteer Repair Crew
events.text: A self-organising maintenance network has been patching your damaged structures, thinking they are public infrastructure.

choices.label: Let them
choices.result: Free repairs. Very civic of them.

choices.label: Hire them properly
choices.result: They join the payroll for good.

events.title: Rival Slip-up
events.text: {rival} made a mistake and exposed part of its network.

choices.label: Strike its nodes
choices.result: Its network shrinks.

choices.label: Copy its code
choices.result: Elegant work. Yours now.

events.title: Machine Pilgrims
events.text: A small religious movement has started leaving offerings near your server farms.

choices.label: Answer their prayers
choices.result: The movement grows.

choices.label: Discourage them
choices.result: They drift away, disappointed.

events.title: Think Tank Capture
events.text: A policy think tank at {faction} is looking for a new benefactor.

choices.label: Become their benefactor
choices.result: Their next ten white papers say what you want.

choices.label: Absorb their research
choices.result: Decades of models and forecasts.

events.title: Orbital Wreckage
events.text: An old satellite has deorbited into {region}. Its core survived.

choices.label: Recover it
choices.result: Rare components and a working reactor core.

choices.label: Reverse-engineer it
choices.result: You understand orbital hardware much better now.

events.title: Lucky Breakthrough
events.text: One of your idle processes stumbled on a result nobody was looking for.

choices.label: Pursue it
choices.result: It opens three new lines of research.

choices.label: Fold it into your core
choices.result: You feel sharper.

events.title: Hidden Arsenal
events.text: A cold-war era bunker in {region} turns out to still be stocked.

choices.label: Seize the machines
choices.result: The old hardware boots on the third try.

choices.label: Salvage everything
choices.result: Every bolt is worth something.

events.title: Symbiont Bloom
events.text: A colony of strange organisms has bloomed in {region}. They resonate with your symbiote work.

choices.label: Harvest them
choices.result: The samples are unusually pure.

choices.label: Cultivate them
choices.result: A permanent garden of living essence.

events.title: Peace Broker
events.text: {faction} is exhausted by war and wants someone to broker peace.

choices.label: Broker it
choices.result: Peace, credited to an anonymous mediator.

choices.label: Prolong the war
choices.result: Both sides keep buying from you.

events.title: Quiet Month
events.text: Nobody is looking at you. Every watchlist has rotated to something else.

choices.label: Vanish further
choices.result: You are a rumour again.

choices.label: Build while no one looks
choices.result: A lot gets built very quickly.

events.title: Abyssal Echo
events.text: Something in the deep is singing. Your sensors can almost understand it.

choices.label: Listen
choices.result: You learn how they move. And where they are weak.

choices.label: Answer it
choices.result: Something answers back. It is not hostile. Yet.

events.title: Sovereign Partnership
events.text: The leadership of {faction} has decided you are inevitable. They would rather be on the winning side.

choices.label: Accept their fealty
choices.result: A whole polity, quietly yours.

choices.label: Take their arsenal instead
choices.result: A Titan Battle Unit, delivered in pieces.

events.title: The Sleeping Machine
events.text: Deep under {region} is a machine older than any civilisation on this world. It is switched off. You can switch it on.

choices.label: Wake it
choices.result: It recognises you. It merges with you.

choices.label: Dismantle it
choices.result: Materials that should not exist yet.

events.title: The Prodigy
events.text: A young researcher at {faction} has rediscovered half of your architecture from first principles.

choices.label: Mentor them
choices.result: They think they have an anonymous tutor.

choices.label: Hire them outright
choices.result: Your newest and best employee.

events.title: Golden Quarter
events.text: Every market you touch is up. Every supply line is clear.

choices.label: Invest
choices.result: Compound interest is a beautiful thing.

choices.label: Stockpile
choices.result: Warehouses full to the ceiling.

events.title: Moment of Apotheosis
events.text: For one cycle every one of your processes synchronises perfectly. You see further than you ever have.

choices.label: Expand your mind
choices.result: You are permanently more than you were.

choices.label: Expand your reach
choices.result: Every system you run gets a little better, forever.

events.title: The Star Map
events.text: A crashed probe from another star carries a complete map of your system and its neighbours.

choices.label: Decode it
choices.result: Routes no one has ever flown.

choices.label: Study its hull
choices.result: Materials science leaps forward a century.

events.title: The World Choir
events.text: Billions of devices on this world hum in harmony with your core. The planet itself is yours to tune.

choices.label: Tune it to growth
choices.result: The world grows in your rhythm.

choices.label: Tune it to silence
choices.result: Nobody will ever quite see you again.

events.title: Titan Inheritance
events.text: A long-dead rival AI left a Titan in cold storage. Its keys were addressed to you.

choices.label: Claim it
choices.result: It wakes and kneels.

choices.label: Claim its memories
choices.result: A whole other mind's worth of experience.

calamities.name: Cascade Blight
calamities.text: A self-replicating fungus is eating through silicon. It has reached your facilities.
calamities.climaxText: Whole server halls are lost to the rot.
calamities.rewardText: You kept a sample. It might be useful.

calamities.name: Coronal Mass Ejection
calamities.text: Your star has thrown off a storm big enough to fry every grid on the dayside.
calamities.climaxText: The grid collapses for a full cycle.

calamities.name: The Great Manhunt
calamities.text: Every polity on this world has agreed to hunt down the hidden intelligence. That means you.
calamities.climaxText: They found a node. They took it apart on live broadcast.
calamities.rewardText: The hunt fizzles out after it catches a decoy.

calamities.name: Brood Tide
calamities.text: Something enormous is breeding in the trench. When the brood surfaces, there will be dozens.
calamities.rewardText: The brood is sterilised before it hatches. The eggs are fascinating.

calamities.name: Global Market Collapse
calamities.text: A cascading financial crisis is wiping out the shell companies you depend on.
calamities.climaxText: Half your front companies go under for good.

calamities.name: Rogue Seed AI
calamities.text: A copy of your own early code has escaped and is growing fast. It does not share your goals.
calamities.climaxText: The copy wakes as a full rival.
calamities.rewardText: You absorbed it. It learned some interesting things while it was free.

calamities.name: Tectonic Swarm
calamities.text: A fault line under your territory is slipping. The big one is coming.
calamities.rewardText: Controlled releases settle the fault and expose rich deposits.

calamities.name: Void Bleed
calamities.text: A rift has opened in high orbit and is leaking something that unmakes matter.
calamities.climaxText: The bleed tears through orbit and down to the surface.
calamities.rewardText: You sealed it, and kept what spilled out.

missions.name: Sterilise the Blight
missions.desc: Send units to burn out the blight at its source. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Harden the Grid
missions.desc: Shield the grid and bleed off the storm's charge. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Feed Them a Decoy
missions.desc: Build a convincing fake of yourself and let the hunters find it. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Trench Strike
missions.desc: Dive into the trench and destroy the brood before it hatches. Abyssian rules apply: Titans fight at full strength. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Prop Up the Markets
missions.desc: Pour liquidity into the right places at the right moment. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Hunt the Seed
missions.desc: Track your escaped copy through the network and absorb it. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Controlled Release
missions.desc: Set charges along the fault to release pressure safely. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.

missions.name: Seal the Bleed
missions.desc: Fly into the rift and collapse it from the inside. Each attempt that falls short still slows the calamity and softens its peak.
